answers.answer: You may pay the gold and keep the green. The summary allows gold to substitute for any single gem token and does not require spending a matching token first. The spent gold returns to the supply.
answers.evidence: Purchase a Development Card / Payment rules: 'Gold tokens (jokers) can substitute for any single gem token. Spent gold tokens are returned to the supply.'

answers.answer: Yes. Take one red, one blue and one green. The four-token minimum applies only to taking two tokens of the same color. The piles then contain zero red, one blue and two green tokens.
answers.evidence: Take 3 Gem Tokens of Different Colors: 'Take 1 gem token from each of 3 different color piles.' Take 2 Gem Tokens of the Same Color requires 'at least 4 tokens of that color in the supply'.

answers.answer: A direct gold-for-red exchange is not one of the four listed actions and is not a permitted use described by the joker rule. Gold substitutes for a single gem token when purchasing a development card; spent gold returns to the supply.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure lists taking three different gems, taking two same-color gems, reserving a card, and purchasing a card as the four actions. Gold Token Specifics: 'Gold tokens can substitute for any gem color when purchasing a card.'

answers.answer: You cannot voluntarily pass when legal actions are available. You must choose and perform exactly one of the four actions.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: 'On their turn, a player must perform exactly one of the following four actions'.
